status: proposal-only; unmeasured; workflow owned by parent
proposal_yaml:
# Insert immediately after Install cargo-nextest, before Rust tests.
      - name: Setup Rust compiler cache (hosted trial)
        if: runner.environment == 'github-hosted'
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@fc920bf0ec8de6ee65d409111f7ec508035751ba # v0.0.11
        with:
          version: v0.16.0
      - name: Enable Rust compiler cache (hosted trial)
        if: runner.environment == 'github-hosted'
        env:
          CACHE_MODE: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.event_name == 'merge_group') && 'READ_WRITE' || 'READ_ONLY' }}
        run: |
          echo "RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SCCACHE_GHA_VERSION=ifc-rust-tests-v1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SCCACHE_GHA_RW_MODE=$CACHE_MODE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
scope: rust-tests only; initial GitHub-hosted trial; self-hosted unchanged
Install after Clippy and rust-cache restore so Clippy and existing dependency-cache key are unchanged
Keep nextest, doctests, fixture verification, feature/event lanes, opt-levels, debug info, lld, assertions and overflow checks unchanged
Keep rust-cache workspace stripping; no whole-target upload
Main/merge-group seed content cache; PR reads only; PR trial needs seed from accessible base scope or it measures misses
Action exports ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL/ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN and sets v2 cache service; no extra credentials step or permissions expansion
Action post step reports human and JSON stats automatically

cacheability.eligible: Normal non-incremental rlib/staticlib invocations with supported emit/arguments; core, geometry, processing and other pure library invocations are candidates. Hash includes compiler, arguments, dep-info-discovered input contents and extern contents; source mtimes alone do not determine reuse.
cacheability.ineligible: Unit/integration test executable compile+link invocations, binaries, proc-macro crates, dylib/cdylib. Cache cannot reuse only the frontend/codegen part of a rejected invocation. All 403 nextest binaries still need test-mode compile/link work when not Cargo-fresh.
cacheability.mixed_crate_types: Pinned parser rejects an invocation if ANY crate type is outside lib/rlib/staticlib: combined cdylib+rlib invocations (wasm-bindings, diff-wasm, imported-geometry) are not cacheable as a whole. ffi cdylib is ineligible. Inspect actual rustc invocations; do not count manifest rlib entries as assured hits.
cacheability.clippy: Intentionally outside trial; metadata checking must not be presented as saved nextest codegen. Pinned source supports some metadata-only invocations although Rust.md still says emit link is required.
cacheability.limits: No measured eligible fraction of 504s. A high hit count cannot prove large wall-time savings; test-mode compilation/linking may dominate.
cacheability.correctness_caveat: Upstream warns procedural macros that read external files may not be tracked correctly. Audit relevant macros/generated inputs and validate invalidation before claiming no capability loss. Standard derives exist; this research did not establish a complete macro-input audit.

storage.bounded_alternative: Per-invocation content entries in GitHub Actions managed cache, rather than retaining a whole workspace target. Main/merge-only writes limit PR churn. Namespace permits invalidation. Repository cache quota/eviction still applies; no hard per-job byte bound is established by this patch. SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE would limit local disk backend, not GHA backend.
storage.qualification: Record entry count/bytes and eviction effects on existing dependency/fixture caches. Do not archive Cargo targets or executables as evidence.

qualification: Parent applies trial and seeds from main or an accessible base scope; preserve baseline workflow and fixture inventory. No runs were submitted here.

Measure cold fill and at least three independent fresh-runner warm/control pairs on same source/toolchain/runner class; controls use original commands. Include action install, remote lookups, cache writes/post cleanup and full job wall time, not just compile timers. Avoid same-target in-job repeats that are merely Cargo-fresh.

Collect per-phase elapsed time, complete sccache JSON/non-cacheable reasons and representative verbose rustc commands; attribute hits to workspace rlibs and establish how much of compile time is actually reusable.

Compare discovered test names, pass/skip reasons and doctest inventory, not just totals; for baseline source require 6780 passes and same 41 intentional skips. Fixture check remains mandatory; no new skip or missing binary is acceptable.

Warm-cache invalidation checks must change a real library source and a tracked included/generated input and show appropriate misses plus unchanged unaffected hits; inspect macro file reads. Keep compiler/profile/feature invalidation enabled; do not add path or timestamp hacks.

Retain only if repeated total job savings exceed observed runner variation with no correctness/inventory regression, cache errors, or harmful quota churn. No speedup claimed until measured. Qualify self-hosted separately for daemon ownership/env/collision and runtime Node24 support before extending trial.
rollback: Remove the two inserted steps; no source/config/test rollback needed.
On stale-input evidence, inventory drift, wrapper failures, or absent net warm-job benefit, disable trial immediately.
To invalidate remote trial entries, bump SCCACHE_GHA_VERSION or delete only matching trial cache entries; never clear unrelated caches.
rejected: Do not enable cache-workspace-crates broadly without Cargo fingerprint/source-mtime evidence across fresh checkouts. Exact dependency cache hit is not evidence that test compilation should have been fresh.
validation_performed: Read policies, fleet status (Pop/PC reachable with active jobs, Mac disabled), live workflow/profile/manifests, required main checks, baseline log, and upstream pinned docs/action/parser sources. No builds/tests/workflow edits or agents.
